thread:
nora.docs: Pushed a tiny PR to consolidate a single compact tool-calling + structured-output example we can reuse in the quickstart and SDK pages. Goals: minimal surface, show a small JSON-schema, include a regex fallback hint, and fix two stale links. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3555

kevin.eng: Can we paste the snippet here? want to make sure the SDK examples match our client method names. keep it short.

nora.docs: Sure, here's the recommended minimal example. It's intentionally tiny and assumes a non-streaming response.

nora.docs: ```json
{
  "tool": "inventory.get",
  "input": {"id": "SKU-123"},
  "expected_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "qty": {"type": ["integer", "null"]},
      "location": {"type": ["string", "null"]}
    },
    "required": ["qty"]
  }
}
```

rachel.reviewer: Quick feedback: prefer inventory.lookup for parity with other SDKs, and note that some backends omit location so allowing null is good. Also add a one-line comment showing a fallback regex like `// fallback: /qty:\s*([0-9]+)/`.

kevin.eng: Agree on the method name. Also add a parenthetical: (assumes non-streaming response) because chunked streaming would require incremental parse handling. maybe one sentence in the docs page is enough.

nora.docs: Updated in PR: method renamed to inventory.lookup, added nullability for location, and included the fallback regex comment. Also fixed links: `/guides/tool-calling` -> `/docs/tool-calling` and removed a dead anchor in `/docs/structured-output#patterns`.

link-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining.

ops-note: Heads-up for Dedicated teams: we'll add a note in the Dedicated runbook about the streaming caveat and recommend example variants for streaming responses.

rachel.reviewer: Approving the content. small nit: add a one-line note that the snippet is for quickstart and a fuller example exists on the structured-output page.

nora.docs: Added that sentence and a pointer to the longer example. CI: docs-lint passed, snippets-smoke passed. Merging after changelog update.

kevin.eng: Thanks — will sync the SDK quickstart to use the new snippet in the next patch.

nora.docs: Merged and backported to stable. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
